spec.name: tenet_governed_memory_everos_patterns
spec.purpose: Governed event-sourced memory with external anchors, scope grants, and retrieve-as-data, plus scan-first migration discipline, all restated in our own words

summary: Patterns from Rishikiran98/HIEROMEM (TENET, MIT) and EverMind-AI/everos-plugins (Apache-2.0), plus ideas only from 1476989162/memagent (repo 404s, LICENSE unread) and memoryagent-lib (repo identity unconfirmed, LICENSE unread): an append-only hash-chained event log as the only source of truth with external anchors kept off the log host; scope grants giving one task its namespaces, tools, action budget and expiry, with retrieval unable to cross the grant; a pure-function governance gate where unmatched means DENY and escalations fail closed; retrieve-as-data with a why-chain audit view; journal reconciliation that never retries an effect; and a scan-first migration discipline (report without editing, pre-flight gate before the first change, snapshot plus own branch, stop and ask on anything unmigratable, lead with what will still fail). All restated in our own words, stdlib-only, no provider/network/API-key/server/MCP/GPU/model-weight/payment code.
